label: At D2, candidate rises after rare a1->S2 transitions, falls after rare a2->S1.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (state==1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 r")
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 44 is timing-dominated (high at GO, negative at D2). Beyond timing its magnitude is set at D2 by the observed choice x reached state: a1 then rare S2 raises it strongly (+0.57 relative to a2->S2), a2 then rare S1 lowers it (-0.26), a1->S1 slightly lowers it (-0.12). The short form scores ~0.80 dev. The free fit (0.87 dev) adds a D1 drop after an unrewarded S2 outcome, a small D1 rise after rewarded S1, and a D2 boost when the previous trial was a1 S1 rewarded; belief_lo terms add little. GO is essentially unmodulated. No future variables used.

issues: The label leaves out the third short-form term, a1->S1 at D2 (weight -0.117). Dropping that term lowers test R^2 from 0.788 to 0.723, so it carries real signal that a reader of the label alone would miss.

The explanation's numbers check out. On test the short form scores 0.788 with weights +0.568 (a1->S2), -0.262 (a2->S1) and -0.117 (a1->S1), all relative to a2->S2. GO residuals stay within about 0.02, so GO really is unmodulated. The belief_lo terms add little: putting a D2*belief_lo term in place of a1->S1 gives 0.777.

Misses on the short form show one systematic error class: it over-predicts after an unrewarded S2 outcome, at D1 (a1 S2 u -0.145, a2 S2 u -0.120) and at D2 (a1 S2 u -0.072, a2 S2 u -0.053). It also under-predicts D1 after a rewarded S1 outcome (a2 S1 r +0.089, a1 S1 r +0.046) and D2 after a1 S1 r (+0.060). These are small next to the +0.57 D2 effect.

Within the a1->S2 cell the activation varies a lot (-0.1 to -0.59 in the worst windows), and it is lower when the previous trials were also unrewarded rare S2 visits. No short form within the 3-term limit captured this: D2*last_is('a1 S2 u') and belief interactions did not help.

A slightly better short form that passes --short merges a1->S1 and a2->S1 into one D2*(state==1) term and adds a term for the post-unrewarded-S2 drop at D1 and D2. It scores 0.806 on test, against 0.788 for the recorded form.
